sections.title: Challenges
sections.note: 15 dream challenges from Shisho; new ones unlock as you clear dungeons. Free to play.

items.name: Blank-Slate Battle
items.howTo: Talk to Shisho and clear the challenge within the goal time (1:00).
items.notes: No Echoes or items, Tri Lv. 1, 3 hearts. Enemies: Deku Baba, Keese, Octorok, Spear Moblin.
